source_status: Source-owned Batch 45 corrective task list. A04 covers T23/T24, A05 covers T25-T27 and A06 covers local T28/T29 implementation plus focused deterministic checks. T28 replaced the unaccepted 196-record manifest and legacy T18-T22 block with semantic packet cases; T29 added deterministic evidence aggregation integrated at the promotion contract. This is not CLI/runtime activation, live/provider/model or external reviewer behavior, promotion or production evidence.
goal: Recover Batch 45 Professional Code Authoring around the user outcome: a non-programmer should receive the smallest safe, readable and performant patch, with risk-selected tests and intent-focused comments, without generating a second codebase of low-value tests or policy prose.

user_outcome.primary_user: mass user or vibe-coder who cannot independently design code, architecture and test strategy
expected_behavior: Search existing project capabilities, standard libraries and framework primitives before adding custom code.
Produce the smallest safe patch that preserves named invariants and project conventions.
Select unit, property, characterization, contract, integration, end-to-end, mutation or performance checks only when the changed risk justifies them.
Use comments and public API documentation for non-obvious intent, invariants, trade-offs and operational boundaries rather than narrating obvious syntax.
Measure correctness and relevant performance with deterministic evidence before any model-quality or promotion claim.

audit_basis.research_assessment: The research corpus and smallest-safe-patch principles remain useful; the main failure is incomplete runtime translation and weak measurement.
audit_basis.implementation_gap: The active implementation is dominated by workflow/checklist text and comment-sufficiency heuristics; language/tool profiles, risk-based test selection, deterministic quality metrics and performance routing are not durably wired.
audit_basis.test_gap: The focused suite is green while the promotion route has zero valid pairs; the large artifact test mainly protects historical JSON and Markdown values rather than code-authoring behavior.
audit_basis.eval_gap: T18 strict output requirements are not implemented as one durable executable contract, primary behavior scores are model-emitted, treatment variables are confounded and the held-out corpus is not representative of the mass-user multi-stack goal.
audit_basis.latest_gate: B45-POSTQ4-T21-COST-WAIVED-RUN-A01 aborted on tests_or_checks.status schema validation; B45-POSTQ4-T22-A02 remains no-go with valid_pair_count=0 and reviewer not run.

design_principles: Keep the book and standards research as a curated knowledge base; retrieve only stack- and risk-relevant rules for a task.
Generation context gets a compact code-change contract; richer evidence mapping belongs in deterministic tooling and independent review.
Test selection follows changed risk and fault-detection value, not line coverage, test count or a universal test-to-code ratio.
Model self-scores are diagnostic telemetry only and cannot be the primary promotion metric.
Performance checks are required when a hot path or performance claim is affected and are otherwise explicitly not applicable.
No future provider/model/reviewer run starts until the local executable contract, fixtures, corpus and isolated treatment are frozen and green.

agent_team_design.owner_role_semantics: owner_role remains the task's functional accountable role; writer, verifier, independent reviewer, claim gate, docs owner, skills, write scope and handoff order are authoritative in the linked task assignment.
agent_team_design.team_ready_claim_ceiling: Complete local handoffs and ownership only; no agent dispatch, task implementation, runtime behavior or promotion evidence.

tasks.title: Implement one durable promotion output contract
tasks.objective: Move the T18 primary-result JSON Schema and normalization rules into a versioned runtime module used by the real runner, including tests_or_checks status handling, unknown-field rejection, score ranges and invalid-pair quarantine.
acceptance: The durable runner and source-owned schema share one version and one enum source.
No temporary or one-off adapter is required to validate a primary result.
Invalid output is classified before aggregation and cannot silently enter reviewer or promotion logic.
stop_conditions: Stop if the implementation duplicates the schema in multiple mutable sources.
Stop before any provider/model/reviewer call.

tasks.title: Add red-green schema and normalization fixtures
tasks.objective: Prove the executable contract with one valid fixture and focused negative fixtures for every required field, enum, range, malformed array, unknown field, timeout, no-op and normalization rule.
acceptance: Every documented invalid-output class fails before the fix and passes after the expected validator behavior is implemented.
The exact T21 tests_or_checks.status failure has a regression fixture.
Fixture validation requires no live model or provider call.
verification: Mutation or seeded-corruption check over the validator
No raw prompt or private source retention
stop_conditions: Stop if tests only assert that schema text exists.
Stop before any external call.

tasks.title: Replace generation-time checklist injection with a compact code-change contract
tasks.objective: Define a maximum-eight-field pre-edit contract covering existing capability, smallest safe patch, invariants, risks, selected tests, comment decision, performance applicability and evidence/gaps; keep the full research mapping out of normal generation context.
acceptance: Generation context uses the compact contract and does not paste the full standards/checklist by default.
Each field changes an implementation, verification or stop decision; decorative evidence fields are removed.
The full checklist remains reviewer/reference material or is retired with a documented compatibility path.
verification: Review against the research principles and T11 compact-card design
stop_conditions: Stop if the compact contract recreates the 128-line checklist under a new name.
Stop if compatibility behavior is not explicit.

tasks.title: Implement project-native stack and risk selection
tasks.objective: Detect the target stack and existing formatter, linter, type checker, test runner, build tool and project utilities, then select only applicable authoring rules and commands.
acceptance: Profiles cover at least Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, one compiled systems family such as Go or Rust, and one enterprise OOP family such as Java or C#.
Detected tools remain present_unverified until current commands prove them.
Missing tools do not cause dependency installation or invented universal thresholds.
stop_conditions: Stop before dependency installation, target mutation or external tool activation.
Stop if detection is treated as verified runtime evidence.

tasks.title: Implement risk-based test, comment and performance selection
tasks.objective: Map changed behavior and risk to the smallest useful test set: unit/property for pure logic, characterization for legacy behavior, contract/integration for boundaries, end-to-end for critical user flows, mutation for high-risk rules and benchmark checks for affected hot paths.
acceptance: Every selected test type names the risk or invariant it protects.
TDD, end-to-end, mutation, coverage and benchmarks can be not_applicable with a reason instead of being forced.
Comments are selected for intent, invariant, trade-off, compatibility, concurrency, security or operational boundaries, not line narration.
Performance evidence is mandatory only for affected hot paths or explicit performance claims.
verification: Negative cases preventing unnecessary test layers
stop_conditions: Stop if line coverage or test count becomes the correctness target.
Stop if every task receives every test type.

tasks.title: Reduce Batch 45 artifact-test debt without losing fault detection
tasks.objective: Replace repeated per-packet exact-value assertions with generic schema, registry, traceability and parameterized invariant checks; separate cold historical packet validation from active behavioral and runtime contract tests.
acceptance: Record the current 4627-line and repeated-assertion baseline before refactoring.
Reduce repeated historical exact-value assertions by at least 50 percent or record a source-owned exception for each retained family.
Seeded packet corruptions and runtime-contract mutations still fail the appropriate tests.
No universal test-to-production LOC ratio is used as a gate; LOC and assertion counts remain anomaly signals.
verification: Before/after test LOC and assertion inventory
stop_conditions: Stop if tests are deleted without proving that equivalent fault detection remains.
Stop if history is rewritten or evidence IDs are changed.
tasks.attempt_evidence: Baseline repeated-family count 196 and combined test LOC 8130; repaired count 34, retained owned exceptions 3 and combined test LOC 5658. The 48-test T28 route passed, including seeded packet corruptions and retained legacy boundaries.

tasks.title: Replace self-score promotion with deterministic quality metrics
tasks.objective: Define promotion inputs from actual diffs and checks: acceptance correctness, regression status, seeded-fault or mutation detection, patch size/churn, dependency delta, project-native tool results, relevant performance delta, latency and token/cost evidence.
acceptance: Primary-model behavior_score and dimension_scores are diagnostic only.
Promotion aggregation uses deterministic evidence plus a separate reviewer verdict.
Patch size and test size are anomaly signals requiring explanation, not optimization targets.
A performance claim cannot pass without a current benchmark; unrelated tasks record not_applicable.
stop_conditions: Stop if a warning count, coverage percentage or model self-score can independently promote the treatment.
Stop if missing evidence is converted to zero or success.
tasks.start_gate: Satisfied by T28 semantic cases: repeated-family count 34, retained exceptions 3, combined test LOC reduced and 48 focused tests passed.
tasks.implementation_evidence: 23 focused metric and promotion-contract tests passed. Missing required evidence blocks; conditional performance/cost evidence is typed; self-scores remain diagnostic only.

tasks.title: Implement an independent blinded reviewer contract
tasks.objective: Review baseline and treatment patches without arm labels and score correctness, minimality, readability, test strength, maintainability, security/privacy and relevant performance using evidence separate from the primary model output.
acceptance: Reviewer input excludes baseline/treatment labels and primary self-scores.
Reviewer verdict is blocked until deterministic pair evidence is valid.
Critical correctness, security, data-loss or regression findings override averages.
stop_conditions: Stop before a live reviewer call without exact approval.
Stop if the reviewer receives the arm label or target verdict.

tasks.title: Build a representative multi-stack held-out corpus
tasks.objective: Replace the internal-only eight-task corpus with 12 to 16 sanitized or synthetic tasks spanning at least four stack families and multiple risk classes, including small changes, legacy bugs, boundary changes, unnecessary-abstraction traps and performance-sensitive work.
acceptance: At least four stack families and five risk classes are represented.
Tasks are frozen with hashes before treatment output is inspected.
Fixtures contain no secrets, private source bodies, raw chats, customer data or absolute user paths.
The corpus contains tasks where the correct result is deletion, configuration, reuse or no new code.
stop_conditions: Stop if the corpus is tuned after treatment inspection.
Stop if a task requires unauthorized target access or external data.

tasks.title: Freeze an isolated treatment and executable prompt contract
tasks.objective: Version and persist the exact baseline and treatment prompt/context templates so the primary comparison changes only the compact pre-edit contract; evaluate reviewer assistance and comment advisory as separate later factors.
acceptance: Baseline and treatment use the same model, reasoning effort, runner, timeout, tools and corpus.
Only one planned intervention differs between primary arms.
Exact prompts and context digests are versioned and reproducible without raw private data.
Full research/checklist text is not injected into every generation prompt.
stop_conditions: Stop if multiple behavior interventions change in the same comparison.
Stop if prompts are ephemeral or cannot be reproduced.

tasks.title: Run the local promotion-readiness preflight
tasks.objective: Prove locally that the executable schema, normalization, deterministic metrics, reviewer gate, frozen corpus and isolated prompt contract are reproducible before preparing any new live approval packet.
acceptance: All valid local fixtures pass and every invalid fixture fails with the expected class.
Seeded faults are detected by the intended test or metric.
Reviewer gating and blinding work on synthetic pairs.
No provider/model/reviewer call is made.
stop_conditions: Stop and keep no-go if any schema, seeded-fault, blinding or reproducibility case fails.
Stop before approval-packet creation when local readiness is not green.

tasks.title: Prepare, execute and decide a new promotion eval only after exact approval
tasks.objective: After local readiness and a separate exact owner approval, run the frozen same-model comparison, invoke the independent reviewer only after all pairs are valid, and issue a promotion/no-go decision from deterministic evidence plus reviewer findings.
acceptance: A new exact approval names model, effort, call cap, timeout, cost policy, retention and reviewer policy.
All promotion-counted pairs are schema-valid and have deterministic acceptance evidence.
The independent reviewer gate runs and has no unresolved critical finding.
Any latency, token, cost or performance regression outside the frozen tolerance blocks promotion or is explicitly owner-accepted.
The final decision preserves no-go when evidence is incomplete, invalid or mixed.
stop_conditions: Stop before every provider/model/reviewer call unless the exact approval is present and unconsumed.
Stop on first invalid schema, unauthorized cost/timeout drift, privacy breach or critical reviewer finding.
Do not reuse an approval after any call starts.

does_not_authorize: Hook, CI blocker, schedule or automation activation
Git branch, stage, commit, push or pull request
rollback: Historical T18-T22 evidence remains immutable and continues to own the failed route.
Each implementation task must remain revertible by removing only its new module/template/test files and restoring the previous advisory-only selector.
A failed local or live gate returns Batch 45 to advisory-only/no-go without deleting evidence.
claim_ceiling: A04 proves local T23/T24, A05 proves local T25-T27, and A06 proves local T28/T29 implementation with focused deterministic verification. A06 shows semantic test compaction and a deterministic promotion-evidence contract only; it does not prove T30-T34, multi-language runtime enforcement, model behavior improvement, CLI/runtime or hook activation, live/provider/model/external-reviewer behavior, promotion, release readiness or production readiness.
